tools.name: add_rule
tools.description: Add a hard rule to the user's rulebook, enforced on every later tool call in every session. Call it when the user corrects how you acted or states a lasting rule about commands, git, files or tools ("never X", "always ask before Y", "don't touch Z"), in addition to saving a memory. Make the pattern as narrow as the rule: a JavaScript regex on one input field of the tool. Use action "confirm" when the user wants to be asked first, "deny" when the thing should never happen.
